# tripto.to

> tripto.to is a free, privacy-first travel planner and progressive web app (PWA). It organizes trips, flights, hotels, day plans, documents and offline itineraries, and includes on-device tools for weather, currency conversion, tax-free (VAT refund) guidance and eSIM options. Trip data stays private: purchase amounts and precise location are never sent to tripto.to.

## Pages

- [tripto.to app](https://tripto.to/): The tripto.to travel-planning progressive web app.
- [Overview](https://tripto.to/landing): What tripto.to does and who it is for.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tripto.to/privacy): How tripto.to handles trip data.
- [Terms of Service](https://tripto.to/terms): The agreement for using tripto.to.
- [Cookies & local storage](https://tripto.to/cookies): How tripto.to stores data on your device.
- [Contact](https://tripto.to/contact): Get help with your account or a trip.

## Resources

- [AI catalog](https://tripto.to/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable catalog of tripto.to resources for AI agents.
- [Sitemap](https://tripto.to/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of public pages.
- [Web app manifest](https://tripto.to/manifest.webmanifest): PWA installation manifest.

## Notes

- tripto.to is client-rendered. Public, crawlable content lives on `/`, `/landing` and the legal pages; the in-app trip routes are private and marked `noindex`.
- Currency, tax-free and weather calculations run on the device. tripto.to never stores or receives your precise location or purchase amounts.
